carousels.name: 3.2% sounds small. It's millions of people.

slides.title: "Only" 3.2% are at risk of p*rn addiction. [[That's millions of people.]]
slides.sub: What the largest international study really means.

slides.title: The [[conservative]] number
slides.body: In the International Sex Survey (Bőthe et al., 2024), 3.2% of 82,243 people were at risk of problematic p*rn use — on the strictest measure.

slides.title: On [[other]] measures
slides.body: Using other screening tools, the same study found rates up to 16.6% — with men reporting the highest levels of problematic p*rn use.

slides.title: Percentages [[hide]] people
slides.body: Even 3% of adults worldwide is tens of millions of people struggling with p*rn. You're not a rare case. You're one of many.

slides.title: Numbers don't [[heal]] you.
slides.body: Knowing you're not alone helps. Doing something about p*rn helps more. Be a statistic that recovers.
